# Agentic Marketing Platform

A multi-agent system for governed, simulation-driven B2B marketing content. Specialized LLM agents are orchestrated through a LangGraph decision loop over a SimPy market simulation, with retrieval-augmented generation, contextual-bandit optimization gated by off-policy evaluation, and human-in-the-loop governance.

> Public, de-identified release of a master's-thesis platform. Company-specific data, the RAG knowledge base, and brand / persona / product configuration have been removed. This repository contains the engineering and architecture only. Provide your own data and configuration to run it end to end.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-blue)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

## Overview

The platform turns a campaign brief into governed, citation-backed marketing content. LLM agents draft and critique copy, a retrieval layer grounds factual claims in an approved source, a bandit policy chooses between content strategies, and an off-policy evaluation gate estimates lift before anything is deployed. A SimPy market model provides synthetic engagement so policies can be evaluated offline, and a Streamlit console plus a Prometheus/Grafana stack make the whole loop observable.

## Decision pipeline

The LangGraph `StateGraph` in `src/ai_layer/orchestration/langgraph_supervisor.py` wires the campaign workflow:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[market_observation] --> B[strategy_optimization]
    B --> C[content_generation]
    C --> D[safety_validation]
    D -->|pass| E[cost_check]
    D -->|low score| C
    D -->|needs review| H[human_review]
    H -->|approved| E
    H -->|rejected| C
    H -->|pending| X
    E -->|within budget| F[simulation]
    E -->|budget exceeded| X[END]
    F --> G[marl_gating]
    G -->|promoted| I[golden_test_gate]
    G -->|rejected| X
    I -->|deploy| J[deployment]
    I -->|canary| K[canary_deployment] --> J
    I -->|blocked| X
```

Safety failures route back to regeneration, borderline drafts go to a human queue, the cost node can halt a run on budget, and simulated results must clear the MARL/OPE gate and a golden-test gate before deployment. When the MARL gatekeeper is disabled, simulation routes straight to the golden-test gate.

## Agents

Under `src/ai_layer/agents/`:

| Agent | Role |
|---|---|
| `ContentGeneratorAgent` | Drafts platform-specific copy from the campaign brief and retrieved context |
| `SafetyValidatorAgent` | Scores drafts against a configurable rubric (toxicity, factuality, brand alignment, compliance) and checks claims against the claim library |
| `StrategyOptimizerAgent` | Picks the content strategy using the bandit policies |
| `MarketScraperAgent` | Gathers market observations that feed the first pipeline node |

`ollama_integration.py` routes generation to a local Ollama server as an alternative to the OpenAI API.

## Learning and optimization

- Contextual bandits in `src/ai_layer/learning/`: LinUCB (`linucb.py`) and Thompson Sampling (`thompson_sampling.py`) select among content strategies
- Off-policy evaluation gate (`src/ai_layer/marl/ope_gating.py`): combines inverse propensity scoring with a direct-method estimate (the DR estimator) and confidence intervals over historical data; policies are promoted only above a configurable lift threshold and minimum sample size
- Policy training (`src/ai_layer/marl/policy_trainer.py`) and canary rollout (`src/automation_layer/deployment/canary_rollout.py`) for staged promotion
- Episodic memory (`src/ai_layer/memory/episodic_memory.py`) so agents can recall prior campaign outcomes
- Survival model, multi-touch attribution, autonomous MLOps loop, and a simulation-accuracy tracker in `src/ai_layer/learning/`
- MLflow experiment tracking, with a backfill script under `scripts/project/`

## Governance

Under `src/governance/`:

- `hitl_queue.py` and `hitl_validator.py`: human review queue with approve/reject decisions feeding back into the graph
- `claim_validator.py`: factual claims must match an approved claim library
- `competitor_validator.py` and `safety_scorer.py`: comparative-claim and multi-dimension safety checks
- `golden_test_suite.py`: fixed input/output regression gate that runs before deployment
- Prompt-injection shielding (`src/ai_layer/security/prompt_shield.py`) and Perspective API toxicity scoring (`perspective_api.py`)

## Market simulation

`src/simulation/` provides the offline environment the policies are evaluated against:

- SimPy environment (`environment.py`) with customer and competitor agents and a persona factory
- Platform models for blog, email, LinkedIn, and X (`src/simulation/platforms/`)
- Calibration: auto-calibration, an advanced calibration module, a calibration scheduler, and validators that reconcile simulated engagement with reference data

## Retrieval

`src/data_layer/vector_store/` implements pgvector similarity search over SentenceTransformer `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` embeddings, plus a semantic cache for repeated queries. `scripts/project/ingest_knowledge_base.py` ingests a knowledge base you supply (the original corpus is not included).

## Services

`docker compose up` starts 16 services: Postgres (pgvector), Redis, the FastAPI API, the Streamlit dashboard, an RQ worker, Ollama, MLflow, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Promtail, and four exporters (postgres, redis, node, cAdvisor).

- API (`src/api/`): FastAPI with 25 routers, including campaigns, experiments, bandit arms, OPE, governance, calibration, canary, costs, funnel attribution, knowledge base, LLM management, and health
- Worker (`src/worker/`): Redis + RQ queue service, scheduler, and task definitions for long-running jobs
- Dashboard (`dashboard/`): Streamlit console with 16 pages, including Campaigns, Analytics, Experiments, Governance, Cost Control, Agent Memory, Policy Evaluation, Canary Deployments, Market Intelligence, Operations, System Monitor, LLM Management, System Transparency, Data Configuration, and Funnel Attribution
- Monitoring (`monitoring/`): Prometheus rules and alerts, four Grafana dashboards, Loki/Promtail log shipping

## Repository structure

```
src/
  ai_layer/          agents, LangGraph orchestration, bandits, MARL/OPE, memory, prompt security
  automation_layer/  outbound connectors (HubSpot, Mailchimp, Mailgun, email, blog, LinkedIn, X),
                     deployer, mock deployer, canary rollout
  data_layer/        SQLAlchemy models, repositories, pgvector store, semantic cache
  api/               FastAPI service (25 routers)
  config/            configuration service, brand-voice config, encryption helpers
  cost_control/      budget manager and token tracker
  governance/        HITL queue, claim/competitor validators, golden tests, safety scoring
  monitoring/        runtime monitors (campaign, performance, data files)
  simulation/        SimPy environment, persona/customer/competitor agents, platform models, calibration
  worker/            RQ queue service, scheduler, tasks
dashboard/           Streamlit multi-page console
monitoring/          Prometheus / Grafana / Loki / Promtail / Alertmanager config
alembic/             database migrations
scripts/project/     setup, seeding, calibration, backup/restore
scripts/research/    thesis metrics, tables, and visualization generators
tests/               unit, integration, and golden-output tests
```

## Quickstart

Requires Docker, and either an OpenAI API key or a local Ollama install.

```bash
cp .env.example .env        # set POSTGRES_PASSWORD, SECRET_KEY, and LLM settings
make up                     # or: docker compose up -d --build
```

- Dashboard: http://localhost:8501
- API docs: http://localhost:8000/docs

See `SETUP_GUIDE.md` for manual (non-Docker) setup and configuration details.

## Testing and CI

- `tests/unit/`, `tests/integration/`, and `tests/golden/` with pytest (`make test`)
- GitHub Actions workflow runs Black, Flake8, MyPy, and the test suite

## What is not included

To keep this release free of proprietary content, the following were removed and must be supplied to run the platform end to end:

- the RAG knowledge base and datasets (`data/`)
- brand voice, audience personas, product catalog, and the claim library (`config/`)
- the original thesis documents
